srList.sentence: Statistical analysis The Chi-square test was used to determine inter-group differences in HCC detectability on DSA images, Fisher’s exact test to assess differences in HCC and feeding artery detectability on CBCT-CA and CBCT-CHA images, and the Welch t-test to determine differences in the TLC.
